title: The Three-Body Problem
author: Liu Cixin
summary: In the aftermath of China's Cultural Revolution, an astrophysicist makes a fateful choice. Decades later, scientists begin dying and a researcher is drawn into a strange virtual game about a doomed alien world.
readIf: you like hard science fiction with huge ideas and a slowly tightening sense of dread.
skipIf: you want warm, character-driven storytelling, since the cast is secondary to the concepts.

pairings.reason: A more hopeful, human story of what a first signal from space might do to us.
A classic with a similar awe at humanity's place in the universe, but far shorter and more serene.
Another big, patient story about civilisations and survival over very long stretches of time.
